effects.description:
When Power Gauge is at 3 or higher: Recover 50% of percentage damage received from an enemy. and When you begin capturing a Treasure Area with the Power Gauge at 3 or higher and successfully capture it, deals a mid-range area attack and creates a shield that blocks close-range enemies' attacks and movement. This will deal a fixed percentage of damage (25% of the enemies' max HP).
Continues to deal damage to enemies within close range of the shield while the shield is active. This will deal a fixed percentage of damage (7% of the enemies' max HP).
The shield will disappear after it receives damage equivalent to 300% of your max HP or after 5 seconds pass.

skills.detail:
A long-range charge attack with a Knockback effect.
Creates an area that continues to deal a percentage of damage.
Percentage damage is dealt based on the enemies' HP.
This will deal a fixed percentage of damage and will not increase due to a critical hit.
The area is removed after a certain period of time or when you are KO'd.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: Godhead of Environment's Assault

skills.detail:
Skill 2 changes to "Silence" while capturing Treasure.
If you use "Silence", you will stop capturing Treasure and Skill 2 will turn back into "Know Your Place!!!".

Deals a mid-range multiple hit attack while the skill button is held down.
Damage dealt will change based on the enemies' HP.
This will deal a fixed percentage of damage and will not increase due to a critical hit.
Also deals a close-range attack.
Reduces chance of getting pushed away when attacked by enemy while the skill is active.

Deals a mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect after a certain period of time or when the skill button is released.
You are able to move while holding down the skill button.

Become temporarily invincible after use.
skills.name: Know Your Place!!!
